<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<testsuite name="load:self" tests="5" failures="0" time="<varies>">
  <properties>
    <property name="runId" value="<uuid>"/>
    <property name="state" value="COMPLETED"/>
    <property name="verdict" value="PASS"/>
    <property name="requestsSent" value="3"/>
    <property name="succeeded" value="3"/>
    <property name="failed" value="0"/>
    <property name="droppedIterations" value="0"/>
    <property name="errorRate" value="0.0"/>
    <property name="p50Millis" value="<varies>"/>
    <property name="p95Millis" value="<varies>"/>
    <property name="p99Millis" value="<varies>"/>
    <property name="p999Millis" value="<varies>"/>
  </properties>
  <testcase name="threshold: ERROR_RATE LESS_THAN 0.5">
  </testcase>
  <testcase name="threshold: CHECK_FAILURE_RATE LESS_THAN 0.5">
  </testcase>
  <testcase name="check: step 0 BODY_JSONPATH $.ok EQUALS yes" assertions="3">
  </testcase>
  <testcase name="check: step 0 STATUS EQUALS 200" assertions="3">
  </testcase>
  <testcase name="run completed">
    <system-out>requestsSent=3 succeeded=3 failed=0 errorRate=0 p95Millis=<varies> p99Millis=<varies></system-out>
  </testcase>
</testsuite>
